audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers ran Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill, Quinn, Quinn while the packet chart and the entry's own whys run Quinn, Skill, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Aurora, Skill.
audit.why: The mirror slice already rebuilt Aurora's page to the packet chart, so leaving this side alone would publish two different answers per stage.
audit.corrected: All seven rows re-cut in both layers with inverse ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1], [2], [3], [5] and [6] why-strings were generic and described Quinn's spikes on rows that belong to Aurora.
audit.why: Her spikes are Twofold Hex online, the level-3 kit completion, first AP item and 6; Quinn's is level 1 and the pick-threat late.
audit.corrected: Those five why-strings rewritten to the real spike on each row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Effects are attached to the wrong abilities throughout: 'her E blink', 'her W exile', 'root you with her W', 'your Vault knockback'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Across the Veil (W, 22/21/20/19/18) is the leap that turns her invisible — that is the escape. The Weirding (E, 15s) is a blast plus slow with a short hop backward. Twofold Hex (Q, 9s at rank 1) is a curse missile she recasts to drag the curse back through you. Nothing in her kit roots, and Vault is an interrupt plus self-reposition, not a knockback.
audit.corrected: report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], whys[4], spikes[2].text, early, mid, wants.you[1], wants.foe[0] and wants.foe[1] all reassigned to the correct abilities.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to track Twofold Hex as 'her escape'.
audit.why: Twofold Hex is a 9s poke tool; the punishable cooldown is Across the Veil at 22s.
audit.corrected: The focus of every cooldown line moved to the 22s W.

edits.before: Vault resets the spacing whenever he closes. Only take the trade when Aurora's Twofold Hex is down.
edits.after: Her Twofold Hex poke is online at 9s — trade while it is travelling, and she still has no escape yet.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Aurora must walk into your range.
edits.after: Her full kit is online: Across the Veil leaps out of your Vault and she pokes from outside your reach.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Twofold Hex's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: She converts 4-5 into safe poke — The Weirding hops her backward out of the trade faster than your burst punishes it.

edits.before: Youmuu's Ghostblade is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Twofold Hex's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first AP item chunks your squishy frame through Twofold Hex faster than your spike kills her.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Aurora carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in it evens out only because you become a pick threat — flank with R, never take the straight 1v1.

edits.before: At 6 her W exile plus R out-rotates you and you have no burst back — this is her cleanest all-in window.
edits.after: At 6 Across the Veil hides her and Between Worlds slows the whole area — she picks the fight and you cannot leave.

edits.before: Aurora's ult window: her W exile/burst combo with R lets her one-rotation you while you have no real burst back — this is her best all-in level.
edits.after: Aurora's ult window: Between Worlds, 140s at rank 1, drops a slow zone she can teleport across, and Across the Veil hides her — she picks the fight.

edits.before: Bait her E blink with a Vault feint, then re-engage when her only escape is on cooldown
edits.after: Bait Across the Veil, then re-engage — that leap is 22s at rank 1 and it is her only escape

edits.before: Hold her E blink to dodge your Vault knockback and Harrier mark, then re-poke from range
edits.after: Save Across the Veil to leap out of your Vault and Harrier window, then poke from range again

edits.before: Land her Q at max range and root you with her W to burst your squishy frame
edits.after: Curse you with Twofold Hex at 900 range, then recast it back through you

edits.before: Level 1 is yours outright — your range plus Harrier auto-resets let you walk up and chunk her before she has a spell, so leash and immediately contest the wave. The instant her Q poke is online she starts to even it out, so don't sit in her max-range Q farming for free. The key trap: she holds E to blink away from your Vault, so if you dash in and she's already used E you get a free Harrier-marked all-in; if she still has it, expect her to flash-blink out and re-poke. Blind her with Q if she tries to trade autos, but know she ignores it on her Q and root.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours outright — your range plus Harrier auto-resets let you walk up and chunk her before she has a spell, so leash and immediately contest the wave. The instant Twofold Hex is online she starts to even it out, so don't sit at her max range farming for free. The key trap is Across the Veil: she holds that 22s leap to get out of your Vault, so if she has already spent it you get a free Harrier-marked all-in, and if she still has it expect her to leap out and re-poke. Blind her autos, but the blind does nothing to Twofold Hex or The Weirding.

edits.before: This is where she takes the wheel. At 6 her W exile plus R burst out-rotates you — you have no real burst back and you're squishy, so don't get caught standing in her Q. Vault is your only out, and if she blinks it with E you have nothing. Play for plates and tempo, not duels: your R roam is your actual mid-game win condition here, so shove and go make plays in other lanes rather than feeding her a 1v1 she now wins. Only all-in when her E is down AND her ult is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is where she takes the wheel. At 6 Across the Veil hides her and Between Worlds drops a slow zone she teleports across, so she starts and ends the fight while you are squishy with no burst back. Vault is your only out, and if she leaps it with W you have nothing. Play for plates and tempo, not duels: your R roam is your actual mid-game win condition here, so shove and go make plays in other lanes rather than feeding her a 1v1 she now wins. All-in only once that 22s W is down.

edits.before: Track Aurora's Twofold Hex (Blink): Her escape. All-in when it’s down. When it is down — Vault-blind + R her.
edits.after: Across the Veil (22s) is her escape, not Twofold Hex — Hex is a recast curse missile. All-in once the leap is spent.

edits.before: - Aurora Twofold Hex: matchup-defining — Her escape. All-in when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Across the Veil: 22s at rank 1 — the leap that hides her, and her only real escape. All-in once it is spent. - Twofold Hex: 9s, recast drags the curse back through you. - The Weirding: 15s hop-back. - Vault: 12s, spacing only.

edits.before: Track Aurora's Twofold Hex before you commit
edits.after: Track Across the Veil before you commit

edits.before: Her escape. All-in when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Across the Veil is 22s and it is her only escape — engage once it is spent.

notes: Between Worlds carries a derived hardCC flag, but Riot's description gives it damage and slow only — no stun — so the _missing feed's claim that it cancels Behind Enemy Lines was NOT written anywhere. Twofold Hex likewise does not root; the old text's 'root' is an invention.
